description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class for an installer or upgrader wizard in a web application. It manages rendering templates with Twig, handling different installer/upgrader screens, and maintains context for Vue.js components within the installation process.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: An abstract base class for installer and upgrader controllers that renders Vue.js components within the installation wizard, manages different screen states, and provides methods for rendering templates with Twig.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig environment used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template file to be used for rendering.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves the current template file name.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Assigns a Vue.js component to be used in rendering.

methods.name: getComponent
methods.description: Gets the current Vue.js component assigned for rendering.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the attribute bag holding context data for rendering.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization method for subclasses, called in constructor.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook before rendering, can be overridden for pre-processing.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the specified template with Twig, combining context parameters.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Hook after rendering, can be overridden for post-processing.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Coordinates the rendering process and returns a response object.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Gathers and returns parameters for template context, including Vue component data, request info, and application metadata.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Determines the version identifier for assets, either from a build file or current timestamp.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Returns the sequence of screens for installer or upgrader based on application state.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Returns the index of the current screen in the sequence.
